**Round 228 bookkeeping.** C passed round 228 (16 rows, `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true, 0 bugs), and gate 228 published `499c821` to both remotes.
- CALM-1 is complete and DUX-R-2 is closed.
- B-R225-BACK-TO-START-KEY, C-R227-01 and C-R227-02 are closed.

- The task is archived as `tasks/round-228.md` (copied and compared; nothing deleted). `backlog.json` is now v214, and `feature-status.md` and `b-next.json` are updated.

**Round 229 scope.** I split CALM-2 into 2a and 2b (D-29z286). This splits Saba's approved scope; nothing is deferred. 2a covers the text on the timeline and in the dock:
- The "Bars: set a BPM…" line goes. "Audio is not stretched" stays in the BPM field's tooltip and in the status after a BPM is set.
- The "Loop: make a time selection…" line goes. The reason moves to the disabled Loop button's tooltip: "Loop: make a time selection first (Ctrl+L)".
- The "Arrangement · Overview" label goes. The Overview's accessible name and tooltip stay.
- The video caption shows only the file name.
- The empty video monitor becomes a dark box with no text.
- The video track's Mute, Solo and Volume tooltips say "Original video sound" at every lane height.

**Pre-check.** On a scratch copy with these edits, 10 tests in 6 files go red, all of them pinned text. One more file, `tempo.test.ts`, still passes in vitest only because `undefined === undefined`, but fails typecheck. After test-only fixes, 18 files and 319 tests pass. The task has 16 file grants and freezes 1,067 files, including every protected auth and purchase file.

**C's checks.** I captured the screen text of the live lab before the change. C must find exactly those 7 text pieces gone and nothing new added. C also checks:
- the text budget drops by 4 lines;
- element boxes move by at most 1 px;
- the three Loop button states;
- the moved facts are still reachable;
- the video track tooltips, and the monitor with and without a video;
- the auth guard, the WAV export smoke and the Ableton reference rows R1–R6.

The Ableton rows cite Live 12 manual sections 6.1, 6.6, 28.x and 2.2.2, fetched today. Each is a match or a listed deviation; the one inference is marked.

**Order after 229.** RETRO in round 230, then CALM-2b (detail panel, library notice and its dismiss, first-run status, the empty-lane hint), then CALM-3, then the performance work. The regression round goes first at any planning on or after 2026-10-30. Its checks now include CALM-1, and CALM-2a once it is done.

**Gate-228 review findings.**
- **S1 (Mac tooltips show "Ctrl", not "⌘"):** two reviewers raised it, so it is now a question for Saba (SABA-Q-CTRL-CMD-DISPLAY). The current "Ctrl" rule stays until he answers.
- **S6 (old wording in doc 177):** moved to the deferred Low list.
- **The rest:** recorded as signals, not scheduled.

I did not file a new architecture checkpoint request. The one root already has (ARCH-CHECKPOINT-CALM-DIALOG-KEYMAP) covers these questions and got three new inputs. CALM-1 is a finished feature, so root may want to run it now.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, before writing and before handover. Its five final changes are applied, including test fallbacks so A does not have to stop. I changed no app code; the store tree is clean at `499c821`.
